## Actual source/kernel reproduction, 2026-10-03

Exact baseline abcb2276f02acc685eca9ecd00899c3390031fb7 includes #2013. That fix deliberately rejects an anchor absent from navGraph; this first anchor is still present but physically disconnected.

Real seed73 packed commands genuinely complete Storage2,2, DeliveryBay20,2, q1 Shower20,14 and5,14, q1 Cell5,24. Both sorted Shower anchors21,15 then6,15 have hygiene capacity2 and actual physical shower heads with exact V8 sourceOrderId. Build all32 ordinary square walls on the outer9×9 perimeter x18..26,y12..20, one tile away from the first Shower's protected doorway approach. The legal control omits only18,16, leaving31 walls. All real construction orders complete with actual procurement/carry and existing price80/2bricks per square (2560/64bricks vs2480/62).

Public Guard hire and staged prisoner admission at16,16 plus existing hygiene-only regime edits establish actor0; repeat after actual encoded/checksummed V8 capture/decode/restore. Both room anchors exist in navGraph. Independent real queued route from actual actor16,16 to21,15 returns unreachable (4expansions); to6,15 succeeds through door5,16 (143expansions).

| --- | --- | --- |
|closed32wall ring|0Shower ticks, hygiene50920→14920,206routeFailures|same|
|legal31wall ring gap18,16|1428Shower ticks, hygiene50920→50600,0routeFailures|same|

Typed genuine regression is2RED/2legal. The regular action picks first21,15, queues its real route, receives unreachable and returns idle. Every later cycle selects the same first room; second capacity2 remains idle. Exact owners, actual route, actor identity and physical registry assertions are retained; no injected needs/world/actor/verdicts.

## Deduplication/contracts

Fresh successful searches and complete #938/#1006/#2008/#2013 bodies were read. #938/#1006 are inaccessible-room/readout contracts, #2008 invalid target/next-action fallback, #2013 first anchor absent from the graph. This is actual same-action second usable room hidden by a disconnected first anchor, not a duplicate of those cases.

ADR0041 next legal target/action fallback and ADR0007 route work budget remain relevant. Full route search stays in NavigationSystem's existing queue. Physical room readout already walks region portals (rooms/reachability.ts::walkPortals) with a registered door joining regions regardless of current permissions. The proposed ephemeral helper labels physical connected components once per current graph generation, O(regions+portals), then O(1) per candidate; ActionSystem uses the actor's actual position. Existing permission-aware routing/diagnostics, locked-door behavior, queue budget, ranking/capacity/claims, own accommodation, save format, player wording and tariffs remain unchanged. No per-actor/frame A* or interior/per-seat target.

Query proposal awaits parent scope review before source edits. Physically connected does NOT promise permission, and future walls can still invalidate a previously valid route. Existing cache/graph invalidation is the intended bounded mechanism, not a new global path policy.

Observed navigation totals during9000ticks include diagnostic queries: closed210resolved requests/294expansions, legal71/625. Cache makes repeated failures inexpensive; this is a gameplay failure, not evidence of a search-cost regression.

Full raw worker evidence and inert executed probe are being published in docs/research/2026-10-03-disconnected-room-selection on branch codex/disconnected-room-selection-audit-20261003. No browser/native/fixed or producer-negative claim yet.
